prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a rear-end collision claim. Injury: shoulder injury. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1117; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a rear-end collision at a signalized intersection. Insured vehicle reports being struck from behind while stopped at a red light. Police report requested. Claimant reports neck and right shoulder pain and has been transported to urgent care. Liability appears clear on initial review, with the at-fault driver's carrier notified.

Entry 2: Received notice of representation. Claimant has retained counsel, and all further contact must go through the attorney's office. Letter of representation acknowledged and placed in file. Medical authorization forms requested from counsel. Reserve set pending review of medical records.

Entry 3: Spoke with claimant's attorney regarding the status of treatment. Claimant is undergoing physical therapy for a shoulder injury with limited range of motion in the right arm. MRI results requested. Attorney indicated a demand package will follow once treatment reaches a stable point. No settlement discussion at this time.

Entry 4: Reviewed records received from the treating orthopedic provider. Diagnosis notes a partial rotator cuff tear, with conservative treatment recommended before any surgical consideration. Bills and procedure codes logged for evaluation. Medical review referral submitted to nurse reviewer to confirm causation and reasonableness of treatment plan.

Entry 5: Follow-up with claimant's counsel. Demand package received and under review. Requested updated treatment notes and wage loss documentation before evaluation. Diary set for review in thirty days. File remains open, with liability accepted in principle and injury valuation still pending.
